{{Quote|Spice, I got some spice. Have some spice.|Gespar Trin|<ref name="Tempest Feud" />}}
'''Gespar Trin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]],<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> Endregaad was quarantined after a [[Endregaad Plague|viral outbreak]] on the world. Trin took to the streets of Tel Bollin and tried to sell [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to be passers by, which he attempted to pass off as medicinal spice that could be used to treat the disease.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
